{{Top|leg}}
The '''Department of History''' was a department of the [[University of Ruuria/Legends|University of Ruuria]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] scholar [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] was named Emeritus Chair of the department after uncovering the mystery of the ''[[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|Queen of Ranroon]]''.
